author: YourName
name: BallPing
short: Identify Ballsdex spawns from their art and ping the people who want them.
description: Watches configured Ballsdex bots for spawn images, identifies the countryball using perceptual hashing (ported from Meff1u/BallIdentifier, MIT), and pings per-server subscribed members or roles. Bot owners can upload new spawn art to teach it new or updated balls.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user and role IDs that server admins subscribe to ball pings, and the Discord ID of the bot owner who uploaded each extra spawn-art image. Uploaded art images are stored in the cog's data folder. Message contents are not stored. Users can request deletion of their stored IDs.
install_msg: Thanks for installing BallPing! Start with `[p]help ballping`. Hash data and algorithm credit: Meff1u/BallIdentifier (MIT).
